class.name: IfcReinforcingElement
class.brief_description: Definition from IAI: Bars, wires, strands, meshes, tendons, and other components embedded in concrete in such a manner that the reinforcement and the concrete act together in resisting forces. HISTORY New entity in IFC Release 2x2 IFC 2x4 CHANGE Entity made non-abstract. Subtypes IfcTendon and IfcTendonAnchor removed. Attribute SteelGrade removed. Attributes PredefinedType and Role added.
